one's beloved wife: On their fortieth wedding anniversary, the old man cooked a special dinner for his beloved wife at home.
在結婚四十週年紀念日，老先生在家為他心愛的妻子煮了一頓特別的晚餐。
a beloved teacher: Mr. Lin was a beloved teacher, and hundreds of former students came back to celebrate his retirement.
林老師是一位備受愛戴的老師，數百名畢業生回來慶祝他退休。
the beloved: In the old love poem, the young man waits by the window every night, hoping to see the beloved.
在那首古老的情詩裡，年輕人每晚守在窗邊，盼望能見到心上人。
be beneficial to health: Doctors say that walking for thirty minutes every day can be beneficial to health, especially for older people.
醫生說每天走路三十分鐘對健康有益，尤其是對年長者。
a mutually beneficial relationship: The farmers and the local restaurants have a mutually beneficial relationship: fresh food for one, steady income for the other.
農夫和當地餐廳有著互惠的關係：一方得到新鮮食材，另一方得到穩定收入。
have a beneficial effect on: Studies show that listening to soft music can have a beneficial effect on students' sleep and mood.
研究顯示，聽輕柔的音樂對學生的睡眠和心情會產生有益影響。
biological clock: After flying from Taipei to New York, my biological clock was confused, and I felt sleepy at noon.
從台北飛到紐約後，我的生理時鐘亂掉了，中午就覺得想睡。
biological parents: Adopted as a baby, Lisa decided to search for her biological parents when she turned twenty.
麗莎在嬰兒時期被收養，二十歲時她決定尋找她的親生父母。
biological weapons: Many countries have signed an agreement promising never to make biological weapons that spread deadly diseases.
許多國家已簽署協議，承諾絕不製造會散播致命疾病的生物武器。
biological diversity: The rainforest has great biological diversity, with thousands of kinds of plants, insects, and animals.
雨林擁有豐富的生物多樣性，有數千種植物、昆蟲和動物。
a bitter disappointment: Losing the final game by just one point was a bitter disappointment for the whole basketball team.
決賽僅以一分之差落敗，對整支籃球隊來說是極度的失望。
a bitter dispute: The two brothers had a bitter dispute over their father's house and did not speak for years.
兩兄弟為了父親的房子發生激烈的爭執，好幾年都不說話。
a bitter cold wind: A bitter cold wind blew across the mountain top, so we put on our gloves and heavy jackets.
刺骨的寒風吹過山頂，於是我們戴上手套、穿上厚外套。
bitter experience: I know from bitter experience that leaving homework until the last night always leads to poor grades.
我從痛苦的經驗中得知，把作業拖到最後一晚總是會導致成績不好。
to the bitter end: Even though they were losing badly, the players kept fighting to the bitter end and never gave up.
雖然大比分落後，球員們仍堅持到底，從未放棄。
a bitter pill to swallow: Not being chosen for the school team after months of practice was a bitter pill to swallow for Jack.
練習了好幾個月卻沒被選入校隊，對傑克來說是難以接受的事實。
feel bitter about: She still seems to feel bitter about losing her job, and she often complains about her former boss.
她似乎仍對失去工作感到怨恨，常常抱怨她的前老闆。
bizarre behavior: The cat's bizarre behavior, like running in circles at midnight, made us take it to the vet.
那隻貓的怪異行為，像是半夜繞圈圈跑，讓我們帶牠去看獸醫。
a bizarre coincidence: By a bizarre coincidence, my new classmate has the same birthday, name, and hometown as me.
說來離奇的巧合，我的新同學和我同一天生日、同名，而且同一個家鄉。
a bloody battle: Thousands of soldiers died in a bloody battle that lasted for three days near the river.
數千名士兵在河邊一場持續三天的血腥的戰役中喪生。
a bloody nose: The ball hit him in the face during the game, and he left the field with a bloody nose.
比賽中球打到他的臉，他帶著流血的鼻子離開球場。
bloody-minded: The manager was being bloody-minded, refusing every idea we suggested just to make our job harder.
經理故意刁難，拒絕我們提出的每一個點子，只為了讓我們的工作更難做。
a bold move: Quitting a safe job to start her own bakery was a bold move, but it turned out to be a great success.
辭掉穩定的工作去開自己的麵包店是一個大膽的行動，但結果非常成功。
in bold type: Important words in the textbook are printed in bold type, so students can easily notice and remember them.
課本裡的重要單字以粗體字印刷，讓學生能輕易注意並記住它們。
a bold statement: The young player made a bold statement to reporters, saying his team would definitely win the championship.
那位年輕球員對記者發表了大膽的聲明，說他的隊伍一定會贏得冠軍。
bold colors: The artist likes to use bold colors such as bright red and deep blue to make her paintings stand out.
這位畫家喜歡用鮮明的色彩，例如亮紅和深藍，讓她的畫作很突出。
be so bold as to…: Would you be so bold as to tell the principal that his new rule is unfair in front of everyone?
你竟敢當著大家的面告訴校長他的新規定不公平嗎？
a brass band: A brass band with trumpets and drums marched down the street at the start of the school sports day.
校慶運動會開始時，一支有小號和鼓的銅管樂隊沿著街道遊行。
the top brass: Only the top brass of the company were invited to the secret meeting about next year's plans.
只有公司的高層人物受邀參加那場關於明年計畫的秘密會議。
get down to brass tacks: After chatting about the weather for ten minutes, the two sides decided to get down to brass tacks and discuss the price.
閒聊天氣十分鐘後，雙方終於決定談正事，討論價格。
